<action type="say">
Here’s how to move “Teacher Meeting” in Google Calendar without changing attendees or other details:

1. Open Google Calendar on your computer (calendar.google.com).
2. Go to **December 2025**.
3. Find the **“Teacher Meeting”** on **Friday, 12 December 2025** at the current time.
4. Click the event once to open its preview, then click the **pencil icon (Edit)**.
5. In the edit screen, locate the **date field** next to the time (it currently shows **12 Dec 2025**).
6. Click the date and change it to **Saturday, 13 Dec 2025**.
   - Do **not** change the time fields so the time stays the same.
7. Make sure you do **not** remove or edit anything in the **Guests** section (attendees) or the **description/location** fields.
8. Click **Save** at the top.
9. When Google Calendar asks if you want to send update emails to guests, click **Send** (so they’re notified of the new date).

If you’d like, tell me the time zone you see in Google Calendar and the current meeting time, and I’ll double-check that the move keeps the time exactly as you intend.</action>
